set -euo pipefail

tclsh <<'TCL'
puts [info patchlevel]
TCL

tclsh /dev/stdin "$f" <<'TCL'
puts [lindex $argv 0]
TCL

tclsh8.6 - <<TCL
puts $HOME
TCL

wish <<'TK'
button .b -text hi
TK

expect <<'EXP'
spawn ssh host
expect "word:"
send "x\r"
EXP

expect -c 'spawn true; expect eof'

expect -c 'exit 0' <<EOF
this heredoc is data: the program came from -c
EOF
